newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol Murzuk field to start end-96 - sources.
newsitem.headline: Repsol Murzuk field to start end-96 - sources.

text.p: Spanish oil group Repsol will start producing crude from its Murzuk field in Libya at the end of the month, initially forecast at 45,000 barrels per day, industry sources told Reuters on Friday.
A spokeswoman for Repsol declined to comment.
The Murzuk oilfield is jointly run with Austria's OMV AG and France's Total SA.
The field is expected to produce 100,000 bpd by the end of 1997.
The sources said the group is currently negotiating with Libya the exchange of "several" types of Libyan crude for an equal amount of crude from the Murzak field.
